svg.title: Lantern Vale — four production building prototypes
svg.desc: Butchery with an open counter, bakery with a bread oven, smokehouse with fish racks, and tannery with vats and a stretched hide. Isometric vector studies matching the existing barn and sawpit palette. Each has an enlarged view and a compact silhouette preview. Design review only; gameplay artwork is unchanged.

g.text: LANTERN VALE / PRODUCTION BUILDINGS / FIRST PROTOTYPES
Same isometric geometry, muted materials and fine timber outlines as the barn and sawpit.
Dusty rose roof · open counter · chopping block
A clear approach to the shop; preparation stays visible.
Ochre roof · masonry oven · bread display
Warm oven glow, flour sacks and a wooden bread peel.
Slate sage roof · vented door · hanging fish
A taller smoking chamber with a rack and firewood.
Weathered timber · stretched hide · soaking vats
A low work shed keeps the outdoor leatherwork readable.
DESIGN REVIEW ONLY · enlarged details + compact previews · building art and gameplay await review
